name: 80110 · Englewood, CO
findings: ZIP 80110 (Englewood) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80110 (Englewood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 80110 (Englewood) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
